built_features.title: 💻 Core Full-Stack Architecture
built_features.description: Engineered with PHP 8.2 (Backend), Vanilla JavaScript (zero-dependency, lightweight frontend), Tailwind CSS (curated obsidian-plum luxury palette), Hostinger Cloud MySQL, and HTML5 Canvas (300 DPI high-res compositing engine).

built_features.title: 🗄️ Relational Database Engine (7 Core Tables)
built_features.description: Architected 7 production-grade tables with auto-migration: `orders`, `pages`, `page_content`, `reasons_list`, `proposal_responses`, `rakhi_voucher_allocations`, `rakhi_vouchers_vault`, and `affiliate_products`.

built_features.title: 🔌 19 REST API Micro-Endpoints
built_features.description: Built 19 modular JSON endpoints covering order creation, buyer authentication, hint verification, coupon claiming, dynamic template configuration, live stats, and Razorpay payment webhooks.

built_features.title: 🔒 Security, Cryptography & QR Tokens
built_features.description: Implemented SHA-256 password hint verification with salt hashing, 64-character Buyer Edit Tokens, dynamic printable QR codes, anti-tamper sessions, and protection against unauthorized page tampering.

built_features.title: 🎨 5 Dynamic Celebration Themes
built_features.description: Anniversary Timeline (milestone chapters), Birthday Magic (confetti & cake), Perfect Proposal (interactive Yes/No runaway button), Long-Distance Love (timezone clock & letters), and Raksha Bandhan Royal Luxury.

built_features.title: 💾 Persistent Media Vault & Dual-Storage Protection
built_features.description: Integrated dual-storage mirroring on Hostinger (`uploads_persistent/`), client-side & server-side WebP compression, and PHP auto-healing preventing customer polaroids and avatar photos from Git resets.

built_features.title: 🎁 Raksha Bandhan 3-Act Royal Experience
built_features.description: Act 1: Sibling Nostalgia & Remote Fight Meter; Act 2: 3D Shagun Lifafa with Scratch-to-Reveal and Shahi Tamrapatra Certificate; Act 3: Amazon Cash Voucher Reveal & Live Sister Avatar Badge with 60 FPS floating marigold petals.

built_features.title: 📄 A4 Landscape Photobook PDF & Keepsake Poster
built_features.description: Engineered 300 DPI canvas compositing engine that generates a 6-page printable A4 landscape sibling photobook and a royal framed wall poster with QR codes and embedded calligraphic typography.

built_features.title: 🎟️ Pure Lottery Draw & Amazon Voucher Vault
built_features.description: Built a 100% pure random lottery draw (`ORDER BY RAND()`) pulling available vouchers from the vault pool, consolidated into 1 unified master table with single-line non-wrapping formatting.

built_features.title: ⚙️ Complete Admin Control Center & Safe Reset
built_features.description: Full administrative suite: Orders & Sales dashboard, Gift Cards Manager, Sample Gallery showcase, Amazon Affiliate Store settings, and 1-Click Safe System Reset with personal email whitelist protection.

pending_tasks.title: 🌐 Custom Domain Purchase & Global Migration
pending_tasks.description: Purchase brand domain (e.g. soulscript.in / soulscript.com). Update APP_URL in config/config.php, Razorpay webhook callback URLs, OpenGraph WhatsApp preview meta tags, and QR code base links.

pending_tasks.title: ✨ AI-Emoji & Modern Aesthetic Content Polish

pending_tasks.title: 📱 Mobile Viewport & Screen Overflow Fixes
pending_tasks.description: Audit small screens (320px–390px iPhone/Android) to ensure zero horizontal text clipping, perfectly scaled fight meter sliders, and responsive container padding.

pending_tasks.title: 🎁 Amazon India Gift Cards Bulk Purchase Guide

pending_tasks.title: 🛒 Amazon Affiliate Curated Product Catalog
